title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
description: Alice follows a white rabbit down a hole into a nonsensical world of talking animals, a Mad Tea-Party and the Queen of Hearts (1865).

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
description: A beautiful young man stays unchanged while his portrait bears the marks of his vices (1890/1891).

title: Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus
author: Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley
description: Victor Frankenstein's creature turns on its maker in the founding novel of science fiction (1818).

title: Anne of Green Gables
author: L. M. Montgomery
description: An imaginative orphan girl is mistakenly sent to an elderly brother and sister on Prince Edward Island (1908).

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Twelve classic detective stories featuring Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson (1892).

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet and Mr Darcy overcome first impressions in Austen's best-loved novel (1813).

title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
description: Count Dracula travels from Transylvania to England and a band of friends sets out to stop him (1897).

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
description: An orphaned governess finds love and a dark secret at Thornfield Hall (1847).

title: Little Women
author: Louisa May Alcott
description: The four March sisters grow up in Civil War-era New England (1868-69).

title: Crime and Punishment
author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
description: A destitute student commits a murder and is consumed by guilt; translated by Constance Garnett (1866).
